findings.summary: Per-element handler slots were a second implementation with a stored index; each element event list is now a shared `PlatformEventListeners` using `set_handler`, one native setter picks the list from the record's file-input state, the document revision moves only when the listened set changes, emptied lists are erased, and a handler replacing or nulling itself mid-dispatch is safe (fixture-checked).

`dom_target_within` allocated the whole ancestor path; it calls `ui_contains`, and one `ui_tree_parent` step serves `ui_contains`, `ui_is_connected` and `dom_ui_path` (`ui_focusable` keeps its markup-owner-first order, which answers differently for a moved markup node).

Form-control callbacks were compiled twice; `compileUiElementCallback` serves `addEventListener` and handler properties, keyboard/pointer names are defined once and `compileDomCallback` reads a family table.
`matches`, `classList.contains` and the unforced toggle share `elementBoolean` with hoisted class bookkeeping; the native toggle parses the class string once.
`typeof`/`instanceof` answers for element interfaces and observers live in one table; reflected attributes (lang, id, className, type, min, max, step) in one table for reads and writes.
Only one exit of a folded conditional went through the full value pipeline; every folded conditional and `??` operand now does.
A blanket `requireEngine` fallback hid nullable element bindings that recorded the default engine; those bindings record the document engine and the fallback is gone.

The declared element tag was read at three of the tag checks; one `declaredUiTag` accessor serves handler properties, `addEventListener("change")`, `.value` and `min`/`max`/`step` on record-field inputs.
`transform-origin` lowering is one per-property value lowering shared by declaration lists and `el.style.transformOrigin`.

A handler returning `false` cancels the event instead of refusing; `getBoundingClientRect` reports the border box like `offsetWidth`; `font-feature-settings` joins the degraded set; defaulted `UiClientRect` equality, static regexes, docs and test-helper cleanups.
